text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin JF had arrived. 
Gold City was determined to use this race 
to change the way everyone looked at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For her own sake, and for the sake of 
those who believed in her running—she 
declared that she would give it everything 
she had.
